name: Applications & Interfaces
oneLiner: Where people meet AI: chat assistants, copilots inside existing tools, and specialised apps.

analogy.text: A shopfront: customers see the counter and the product, not the warehouse and supply chain behind it.
analogy.breaks: A shop sells the same product every time. AI apps produce different output each time, so interfaces must handle uncertainty, errors and human review.

givesAbove: Value to people, plus usage and feedback that flow back down the stack.
needsBelow: Agents or orchestrated model calls from the layers below.
